summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of greyhound lay-betting simulator with focus on newly-added features (dynamic recovery levels L1-L5, preview-cap Monte-Carlo, batch run-races, bank carryover, daily-stats, odds range filter, liability-cap bust, recovery overrun, stop-win/loss, configurable stake & commission). Backend: 25/25 pytest passed (all flows verified including recovery chain math, dynamic max levels, cap-blocked bust at L0, L1+ cap busts, overrun mode resolves chains past max_races). Frontend: All listed flows verified — L1-L5 toggles render, CapPreview dynamically adapts (5 legend items + 'Reach L5' for L5; only L1 + 'Reach L1' for L1), session creation, batch buttons (×1,×5,×10,×25,×50) all clickable, RecoveryStatus dot count matches max_recovery_level, Stop button immediately flips badge to 'Stopped', welcome text contains 'configurable lay recovery strategies', DailyChart renders trading journal across 95 days. Two stale assertions in legacy test_simulator.py were updated to match commission-aware payout and overrun mode.

ui_bugs.issue: Recharts BarChart emits many 'SVG <rect> attribute height: A negative value is not valid' console errors when sessions have negative total_pnl. The bars likely render incorrectly for losing sessions because the y-scale produces a negative height. Visual chart still renders but losing-session bars may be missing or clipped. Fix by using Math.abs() with a sign-aware fill, or by anchoring bars at zero with a baseline (Recharts BarChart `baseline` / referenceLine + ensure y axis includes 0).

action_items: Fix DailyChart negative-height SVG warnings (likely Recharts <Bar> data shape — ensure y axis domain includes 0 and bars use sign-aware height; may also need Math.abs on dataKey accessor with a coloured fill function based on sign).
(Carry-forward, low priority) FastAPI deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — migrate to lifespan.
critical_code_review_comments: preview-cap key 'L0_cap_blocked' is misleading — it is just bust_L{level} where the cap blocked, but level can be >0 too; comment in code or rename to clarify it's specifically initial-stake cap blocks. Cap blocks at L1+ are silently merged into bust_L{n} alongside chain-exhaustion busts.

preview-cap simulator hardcodes random.seed(42) for determinism — good — but it also calls generate_race() which ignores num_favourites; chain simulation only uses rank-1 surrogate, so num_favourites only multiplies expected_profit_per_race. Acceptable approximation but document it.
next-race endpoint: in 'overrun' mode, if liability cap busts the only remaining recovery chain mid-overrun, session correctly transitions next loop — verified by tests, but worth a code comment.
DailyChart Recharts negative-height issue (UI bug above).

Only outstanding UI bug is DailyChart negative-height rect warnings (chart still renders but losing-session bars likely clipped). Stop-button UI sync from iteration_1 is now confirmed WORKING.
rca of the issue: DailyChart console errors: Recharts <BarChart> is computing bar heights using y-scale that maps negative pnl values to negative pixel heights. SVG <rect> rejects negative height attributes. Root cause is likely either (a) the BarChart's yAxis domain not auto-including 0 or (b) the Bar component receiving raw pnl which can be negative without using the baseline trick. Fix: either set yAxis domain to ['auto', 'auto'] with includeZero, or split into two Bars (positive/negative) using accessor functions, or use a referenceLine at 0 and ensure data has both positive and negative correctly handled by Recharts (latest versions handle this; if on older recharts, upgrade).
